Emfuleni Drowning in Sewage.

By: Mart-Marie Faure | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
A total collapse in infrastructure and service delivery has the towns of Vereeniging and Vanderbijl Park drowning in sewage.

Unique Selling Point:
The Emfuleni local municipality is one of three local municipalities comprising the Sedibeng District in Gauteng. Its the western most municipality in the district with the Vaal river at its southern border. In June Emfuleni was put under administration because of its inability to provide adequate service delivery and due to allegations of maladministration. Gauteng Premier David Makura has promised to rescue the embattled municipality. However it took a court order by the "Save the Vaal" civil organisation to move the province to intervention. Eskom and Rand Water have threatened to shut down services as the council owes millions.The towns of Vereeniging and Vanderbijl Park experience electricity cuts for up to three days per week and water pressure is being throttled. Low water pressure has been hindering surgeries at the Sebokeng hospital.
The collapse in infrastructure maintenance has caused many of the sewage pumps to spill

Summary:
Community unrest and sabotage has stopped workers from entering the Sebokeng water treatment plant. The closure for several weeks has resulted in 150 Mega Liters of raw sewage flowing into the Rietspruit daily. The Rietspruit Waste Water Treatment Plant's effluent is also pumped into the Riet river.This then flows into the Vaal and the raw sewage has now reached the town of Parys.
Everywhere you go in the district sewage pumps are overflowing. Not only is it flowing into the rivers but you find raw sewage in suburban streets and in residents properties.

Case Study:
Emfuleni Municipality Vereeniging Vanderbijl Sebokeng

Press Release:


Years of government promises to turn around the pollution of the Vaal have come to naught. Carte Blanche investigates illness and destruction as rising sewage overflows broken pump stations and pushes into homes and farming areas. In addition, the residents of Emfuleni, on the river, now face drinking water restrictions because of municipal debts. We confront the leaders who have allowed this mess to get so out of hand.

Script:


VAAL CRISIS SCRIPT

V/O This is how people have to live in the Vaal Triangle in Gauteng. Streets are filled with refuse, and streams of raw sewage. The conditions are so horrendous that even rats are dying....

CLAIRE LINK The Emfuleni Municipality is bankrupt and has been placed under administration by the Gauteng provincial government. For years the towns of Vanderbijlpark and Vereeniging and the adjacent townships of Sebokeng and Boipatong have seen a total collapse of infrastructure.

V/O:

Map To date the municipality owes Eskom.. and Rand Water over a billion rands. The entire municipal district towards the West of Sedibeng has been plagued by an systematic infrastructure collapse, which Carte Blanche has been following for more than two years. The Emfuleni municipality’s ongoing inability to provide adequate services, and to rectify a rapidly deteriorating situation, has resulted in millions of liters of raw sewage, spilling daily from malfunctioning pump stations onto land, and eventually finding its way into the Vaal River.

INT Johan Kruger M1 About for the past 4 years the sewerage has been spilling out of pump station 12 into our premises. Constantly. For the last 12 months I could say nearly every day. 24/7

V/O Johan Kruger is a small scale farmer on the outskirts of Vereeniging. He was forced to sell his livestock because the sheep were dying.

INT Johan Kruger M5 The neighbour here, Ralf, he lost 2 horses and my neighbour on that side also had some sick animals. So we are, we actually want to sell and get away here but I don't think anybody is going to be

interested in buying this place.

V/O The entire region is on the brink of a humanitarian and ecological disaster, with serious consequences to human life, agriculture and industry, says Chris Williams from “Save The Vaal Environment”.

INT Chris Williams

Save the Vaal The situation has really exacerbated in the last couple of years. We’re finding most of all the pollution, the acid mine drainage, abattoirs discharging blood and corpses, the faecal effluent, largely through overpopulation … and the e.coli counts and various other indicators have really made this into crisis proportion right now.

V/O When travelling on the highway towards the township of Sebokeng, north-west of Vereeniging, the decay and smell becomes immediately apparent.

INT Mduduzi Tshabala

Vaal Environmental Justice

Ass (CLIP 2) It often happens that people think this is a natural wetland or perhaps a wet spot, but this is actually raw sewerage.

V/O The magnitude of the crisis really hits home when you enter the township.

Claire LINK Nowhere is the infrastructure failure more apparent than here in Sebokeng where raw sewage is literally flowing in the street where people have to continue with their daily lives. I cannot even begin to describe the stench.

V/O As well as the failing infrastructure, the Sebokeng Waste Water Treatment Plant expansion project, has been halted due to a lack of funds, and for the past few weeks the entire plant has been shut down because of civil protests. Residents have blocked the entrance to the plant resulting in a massive spillage..

INT Chris Williams The discharge is about 150 million litres a day of raw

Save the Vaal sewage into the Rietspruit. which then go into the Vaal.

V/O

Ecoli Count table Currently the e.coli count in the Rietspruit is more than 500 times over the limit that is considered safe for human consumption. The sewage pollution is evident from the white foam floating on the water here.

INT Chris Williams

Save the Vaal We’ve heard today alone, several school kids at home with dysentery.

V/O Further South on the outskirts of Vanderbijlpark, Boipatong residents are also suffering from the effects of prolonged sewage pollution.

Daniel Mbete 01:46:22 I went to the doctor and they did an x-ray and the doctor said the sewerage here is killing me.

V/O Like most homes here, Daniel Mbete’s house is cracking, with sewage literally seeping through the floors and walls. He places the blame squarely on the shoulders of the municipality.

Daniel Mbete 01:46:52 I want to have them arrested. This is my health, they should be mindful of that.

Mpho Khang [00:02:38] This situation affects everybody in the Vaal.

V/O Mpho Khang is the spokesperson for the New Horizon Movement. They have been working tirelessly to turn things around in the Emfuleni district.

Mpho Khang When you go to the upper… the upper side of the Vaal, you’ll find the Vaal River. There is sewage spilling inside the river and when you go… when you come to… this is Boipatong where we are. In Boipatong every other street has a sewage spillage. In… in Sebokeng it’s… it’s the same thing. And at the treatment plant nobody is working because the treatment plant is barricaded by people who want jobs… who want to work at that department. So sewage affects us all and nobody is doing anything

about it. When you call the municipality, they tell you that they don’t have money for petrol therefore they cannot send people to assist you.

V/O Instead of repairing the infrastructure, the municipality’s answer was simply to dig trenches, funneling the raw sewage into the channels, streams and rivers… where it all eventually ends up in the Vaal river, and potentially in Gauteng’s drinking water! The daily increase in spillage has resulted in polluting the river as far down as Parys in the Freestate.

V/O When it became apparent that local authorities had failed to get the situation in the Emfuleni Municipal district under control, SAVE THE VAAL obtained a High Court Order in February this year. This has contributed to the Gauteng Provincial Government stepping in and taking the municipality under administration..

CLAIRE LINK

V/O So, who in the end must be held accountable? Gauteng Premier David Makura has taken over the running of the municipality , but our requests for an interview went unanswered. Water and Sanitation Minister Gugile Nkwinti was attending the Brics summit and was not available for comment. Emfuleni Mayor, Jacob Khawe told a radio station that HE was in fact accountable, He agreed to an interview but later changed his mind and cancelled. In the end it was Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs MEC Dikgang Moiloa who agreed to face the music.

MEC CLAIRE: Who is ultimately responsible for the collapse of the Emfuleni Municipality? It is the municipality. It is the people that have been charged with the responsibility to lead that municipality. So, if you say who’s responsible, it is the municipality itself.

CLAIRE: But why did it take so long for an intervention to happen? Local government is an autonomous independent sphere from the province and from national in terms of the constitution, you know. So you don’t just jump in there. There has to be evidence of potential collapse and complete deterioration of services. CLAIRE: We’ve been following this story for two years now and it’s gotten progressively worse. Are you saying that if we go back in a year’s time things would have changed in the Emfuleni municipality? The people of Emfuleni, the people of South Africa deserves better than what is happening so we expect change. We expect an improvement after our intervention. Definitely there will be an improvement. There has to be an improvement. There’s no choice.

INT Chris Williams

Save the Vaal If we don’t have a satisfactory response by mid-August, SAVE’s next EXCO meeting is 25th of August and our only remedy will be to also place a court order on the premier of Gauteng.

V/O Time is rapidly running out to avert what could become a national disaster says Chris.

INT Chris Williams

Save the Vaal The impact, if nothing is done will be that 65% of Gauteng’s industry will be without potable water, 45% of the population will be without drinkable water and that is a catastrophe.

V/O:

Boipatong massacre

The irony of the situation lies in the fact that the very people who were at the centre of the struggle for liberation now have to face oppression of a different kind...

Mpho Khang [00:07:27] Emfuleni Council has failed us spectacularly so. They have failed us spectacularly. The only thing that counsel gets, the only thing that they get is their pay. Nothing else. We don’t have service delivery. As the people of Vaal we are living in this [indistinct] and we are seriously drowning in sewage.

*****

PROMO 10” In the Emfuleni Municipal District in Gauteng sewage is literally flowing down the streets. Where does all this filth end up, and what is being done to remedy the situation?

PROMO 15” Complete infrastructure failure in the Emfuleni district in Gauteng has resulted in raw sewage running down streets, into schools and homes.. and eventually ends up in the Vaal river. UPSOUND: MPHO KHANG Sewage affects us all and nobody is doing anything about it.

PROMO 15” The collapse in the EMfuleni Municipal district in Gauteng has brought the area to the brink of a humanitarian and ecological disaster UPSOUND; JOHAN KRUGER The neighbour here, Ralf, he lost 2 horses and my neighbour on that side also had some sick animals.

PROMO 30” Failing infrastructure resulting in raw sewage running down streets and into people’s homes has created serious health hazards for residents living in the Emfuleni district.… The municipality’s solution is to dig trenches, funneling the waste into the Vaal river and its tributaries. UPSOUND: MPHO KHANG Emfuleni Council has failed us spectacularly so. They have failed us spectacularly. Gauteng Provincial Government is now in charge, but will they find
